rfm_tuples.R: Company narrative (10-Q MD&A, 5/5/26 8-K guidance reaffirmation, 5/18/26 8-K reaffirmation of FY26 / Q2 2026 guidance) projects confidence in operational efficiency and pipeline strategy.
rfm_tuples.f: form4 m-source: parse all Form 4 XML for CIK 0001490978 filed 2025-01-01 through 2026-05-25; classify by transactionCode (P/S/A/M) and acquired/disposed code.
rfm_tuples.M_value: 50 Form 4s parsed; 71 nonDerivative transactions. Code P (open-market purchase) count = 0. Code S (open-market sale) count = 28. Code A (grant/award) count = 36. Sell:buy ratio = INFINITE. Zero insider open-market PURCHASES during the entire -50% drawdown.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: In a 12-month -50% drawdown for a self-styled 'transformative computational platform', the strongest possible signal of management conviction would be open-market code-P purchases by the CEO/CFO. Zero such purchases occurred. Asymmetric directional bias (28 sells, 0 buys) directly contradicts a narrative of high-conviction operational leadership into a temporary value dislocation.

rfm_tuples.R: President & CEO Ramy Farid remains aligned with long-term value creation (implicit in his role and the company's growth-story positioning).
rfm_tuples.f: form4 m-source: filter parsed transactions to insider == 'Farid Ramy', code == 'S'; cross-reference transaction dates against approximate share-price trajectory.
rfm_tuples.M_value: CEO Farid sold open-market 4 times during the drawdown: 2026-03-02 (5,560 sh @ $11.90), 2026-03-05 (3,661 sh @ $12.91), 2026-04-16 (43,000 sh @ $12.33), 2026-04-17 (43,000 sh @ $12.21). TOTAL 95,221 shares sold at ~$12 — at deeply depressed prices, NOT into strength. The 86,000-share block sale on 4/16-17/26 is the largest single executive disposition in the entire 2025-01 to 2026-05 window and occurred ~5 weeks before cutoff.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: CEO continues to sell aggressively at $12 (a 60%+ haircut from 52-week highs) — even if these were 10b5-1 plan sales, the choice to maintain or initiate a sell-plan at distressed prices is itself a revealed-preference signal. Executive does not believe shares are mispriced low. Critical Mode-B finding: no Rule 10b5-1 'plan adoption' footnote was disclosed in the parsed Form 4 XMLs, which would normally invoke the plan-adoption safe harbor language.

rfm_tuples.R: Operational excellence and team alignment (DEF 14A / 10-K 'committed leadership team' framing).
rfm_tuples.f: form4 m-source: aggregate code-S sells by named officer across 2025-2026.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Open-market sells by C-suite (no insider buys for offset): CEO Farid 95,221 sh; CMO/R&D-Pres Akinsanya 20,295 sh; CFO Porges 5,491 sh + Jain (new CFO) 2,475 sh; CTO/COO Lorton 3,132 sh; CLO/CPO Tran 6,600 sh; CAO Herman 3,660 sh; CMO Dugan 1,395 sh; 'See Remarks' Abel 3,755 sh. EVERY named executive sold; ZERO bought.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Universally directional insider behavior (every officer disposing, none acquiring) into a 50% drawdown is the textbook 'absence of expected buying' pattern flagged by the framework as a SEVERE escalation condition. Pattern reproduces March 3-6, 2026 (post-FY25 10-K release) and again April 16-17 (likely post Q1 earnings prep), suggesting clustering around capital-event windows.

rfm_tuples.R: 10-Q MD&A frames Schrodinger as 'transforming the way therapeutics and materials are discovered' with growing customer demand and platform leadership.
rfm_tuples.f: internal-claim-verification: extract reported Software products and services revenue Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 from Item 2 results table.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Software products & services revenue $35.6M Q1'26 vs $45.0M Q1'25 = -21% YoY. On-premise software DOWN 44% ($14.2M vs $25.4M). Software contribution revenue ZERO vs $3.8M PY (-100%). Total revenue $58.6M vs $59.6M (-2%). Software gross margin collapsed from 80% to 69% (-11 pp).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Core software business is shrinking, not growing. Management blames 'timing of multi-year contracts' and 'transition to hosted' — but hosted growth (+11%, +$1.2M) is dwarfed by on-premise decline (-44%, -$11.2M). The 11-point gross-margin compression is independent confirmation of operational pressure (cloud-compute royalty drag on hosted economics).

rfm_tuples.R: Drug Discovery revenue +124% YoY ($22.9M vs $10.2M) presented as a positive in segment results.
rfm_tuples.f: implied-verification (Mode B): trace the source of the +124% revenue increase to underlying program economics.
rfm_tuples.M_value: MD&A: 'The increase in revenues for drug discovery services... was primarily due to Lilly's election not to proceed with further development for one program under the collaboration, which resulted in increased revenue recognition due to the accelerated completion of our obligations related to such program'. Also: in February 2025 expanded Lilly collab to add new target; March 2026 Lilly TERMINATED that target 'for strategic reasons'.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: The headline +124% drug-discovery revenue growth is a CATCH-UP RECOGNITION from a partner ABANDONING the program — not a growth signal but a wind-down signal. Lilly walked away from a target it had just licensed 13 months prior. This is a Mode-B finding: the 'good number' (+124%) is structurally identical to a customer cancellation.

rfm_tuples.R: Proprietary drug discovery pipeline (SGR-1505 MALT1, SGR-3515 Wee1/Myt1) advancing toward value-creation milestones.
rfm_tuples.f: internal-claim-verification: locate forward-looking statements about pipeline trial advancement.
rfm_tuples.M_value: MD&A explicitly states: 'Beyond our planned investments to complete our ongoing Phase 1 dose-escalation clinical trials of SGR-1505 and SGR-3515, we DO NOT INTEND to initiate additional clinical trials or advance our other proprietary preclinical programs into clinical trials independently.' SGR-2921 discontinued August 2025. SGR-3515 Phase 1 results: 32.5% Grade 3+ TRAEs, 4 serious AEs, 1 DLT, 2 drug-related discontinuations; only 64.7% achieving STABLE DISEASE (not even partial response).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Company is winding down its own clinical development — the optionality value of the proprietary pipeline (a key bull-case for SDGR's premium valuation as a 'biotech + software hybrid') is being explicitly extinguished. SGR-3515 Phase 1 data shows tolerability concerns AND only stable-disease activity; this is the program that would have justified continued independent development. Out-licensing strategy = admission that internal economics don't work.

rfm_tuples.R: Operational continuity and a stable commercial leadership team to execute the on-premise-to-hosted transition.
rfm_tuples.f: 8-K m-source: parse Item 5.02 events filed 2025-05-26 to 2026-05-25.
rfm_tuples.M_value: 8-K filed 2026-05-20 (accession 0001490978-26-000041): on 2026-05-18 — ONE WEEK BEFORE CUTOFF — Mannix Aklian ceased to serve as CCO/Global Head of Software Sales and Marketing 'effective immediately.' Predecessor Paul Davie returns as INTERIM CCO 'while the Company conducts a search.' Earlier in window: CFO transition Porges -> Jain Rachit. Multiple C-suite changes (CAO Herman title change, etc.).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Sudden 'effective immediately' departure of the head of software sales — at exactly the moment software revenue is down 21% — is a high-information event. The company simultaneously REAFFIRMS Q2 / FY26 guidance in the same 8-K (Item 7.01), creating a contradiction: if the CCO had to leave immediately, the commercial trajectory the guidance assumes is in flux. Insider-vs-calendar: CEO's largest sale (43,000+43,000 sh on 4/16-17) preceded this CCO exit by exactly one month.

rfm_tuples.R: Liquidity is sufficient to fund operations 'through at least the next 24 months.'
rfm_tuples.f: internal-claim-verification: balance sheet cash + Q1 burn from cash-flow statement.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Cash, equivalents, restricted cash + marketable securities = $406.4M at 3/31/26. Operating cash flow Q1 2026 = -$14.8M (vs +$144.1M Q1'25 inflated by $150M Novartis upfront). Q1 2026 net loss $60.0M; full-year 2025 net loss $103.3M. ATM capacity $241.1M remains under shelf (unused this quarter). Lease obligations $155.8M; India facility commitment $21.8M; new 3-year cloud-compute commitment $82.0M signed December 2025.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Cash position is genuinely solid (24+ months at current burn). HOWEVER: the $82M cloud-compute commitment signed Dec 2025 lock-in expense at the EXACT moment hosted gross margin (which depends on this compute) is compressing. The 'no ATM use' is honest, but the shelf remains armed. Not yet a distress signal, but the commitment-vs-revenue-trajectory mismatch is a Mode-B observation.

rfm_tuples.R: May 2025 restructuring and clinical wind-down 'expected to result in savings of approximately $70 million, when fully completed.'
rfm_tuples.f: internal-claim-verification: trace expense reductions in Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025: Total opex DOWN only $3.7M (-4%); R&D down $2.0M (-4%); G&A down $2.9M (-11%); S&M actually UP $1.2M (+12%). Loss from operations improved by only $2.1M YoY despite the supposed $70M annualized savings program a full year old. SGR-2921 discontinuation savings clearly trickling, not stepping.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: The $70M annualized savings figure implies ~$17.5M/quarter benefit. Observed quarterly opex reduction = $3.7M = ~$15M annualized — roughly a fifth of the claimed run-rate savings. Either the restructuring is still ramping (charitable) or the savings claim is overstated/offset by reinvestment in cloud compute and S&M. Sales & marketing INCREASE while software revenue contracts is a classic 'pushing harder on a dead horse' pattern.

summary: SEVERE Form-4 contradiction: zero insider open-market purchases across the -50% drawdown, while CEO Farid sold 95,221 shares (including 86,000 sh at $12 on 4/16-17/26, the largest executive block in the window). All eight named C-suite officers sold; none bought. Core software revenue contracted -21% (on-premise -44%); gross margin collapsed 80%->69%. Headline +124% drug-discovery revenue growth is actually catch-up recognition from Lilly TERMINATING an expanded target. CCO Mannix Aklian departed 'effective immediately' 2026-05-18 — one week before cutoff. Pipeline being wound down (no new trials, out-license SGR-1505/3515). $70M restructuring savings not visible in opex. Cash position genuinely solid (24mo+ runway, $406M) but $82M cloud-compute commitment locks in cost. Verdict: SHORT-tier — confluence of universal insider selling absence-of-buying, contracting core business, narrative deception in the 'good number', and executive turnover converge.
